output_list.code: function GoodTimeCoin(uint256 initialSupply, string tokenName, string tokenSymbol) StandardToken(initialSupply, tokenName, tokenSymbol) public {}

output_list.reason: The current system of token buying does not take into consideration the current price of the token. Attacker can use this to buy a larger amount of tokens, at a lower cost. A better solution would be to take in a value of a token (in ether), which will be used to determine the amount of tokens to be minted. This would also allow the tokens to be bought at a dynamic rate, not a static rate.
